audit.whatIsWrong: The page chart (Skill / Gangplank / Gangplank / Skill / Skill / Gangplank / Gangplank) does not match the packet chart (Gnar / Skill / Gangplank / Gnar / Gangplank / Gangplank / Gangplank) at rows 1, 2, 4 and 5.
audit.why: The page's own prose sides with the packet at rows 1 and 4 — whys[0] says the Mini opener wins before a barrel is stored, and whys[3] calls Levels 4-5 a clean kill window. But the mirror audit (gangplank__gnar) explicitly decided to leave the chart alone, and a chart flip must be atomic across both layers and both sides.
audit.corrected: Not changed here to avoid contradicting the mirror; raised in questionsForUser instead.

audit.why: All four spikes are present and real: Level 2 Hyper trade, the 4-5 Mega window on a detonating barrel, Level 6 global R, and Sheen/Trinity barrel scaling. Nothing to invent.

audit.whatIsWrong: Remove Scurvy is described only as a cleanse. It also heals, and its cooldown is never given, so the reader cannot bait it.
audit.why: Remove Scurvy is 22/20/18/16/14s and both cures crowd control and restores health. It is one charge: baited by a Boomerang slow, it cannot also answer the Wallop stun or the GNAR! wall stun. Grievous Wounds cuts the heal half of it.
audit.corrected: 18s-at-rank-3 cooldown and the heal added to wants.foe[1], the cooldown block, the do's, and Grievous Wounds added to itemization.
sources: enemyKit Gangplank W cd 22/20/18/16/14, heal flag

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization never mentions Grievous Wounds against a champion whose W restores health on a short cooldown.
audit.why: Anti-heal timing is what decides extended trades here.

notes: The kit file flags Cannon Barrage as trueDamage and _missing raises a 'resistances-invalidated' item from it, but Riot's own description for the R says only 'slowing and damaging enemies' — no true damage.
